GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   D. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   C. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   D. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

10. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   D. Treat Weather as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   B. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   D. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   C. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.

14. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   B. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   D. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

16. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   B. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
